name: yiyuan-accord-codex
description: Helps agents pursue user outcomes by assessing feasibility, coordinating capabilities, correcting work and verifying results within the user's authority.

interface.shortDescription: Pursue outcomes with coordinated, verified work
interface.longDescription: Tell your agent what you want to achieve. YIYUAN Accord is designed to help it assess feasibility, establish necessary conditions, choose and combine native and external capabilities, correct affected work, preserve continuity and verify the result. It works within your choices and permissions. Accord's general collaboration design is supplier-neutral and separate from host adapters; this package provides the Codex adaptation. Actual behavior depends on the host, available capabilities and the task's conditions.
defaultPrompt: Help me achieve this outcome: [describe your goal].
